course_outcomes: Use mass-transfer equipment concepts and applications.
Compute material balances under differing operating conditions.

sources.name: Supplied GTU DI04005021 Mass Transfer-I syllabus

important_qualifications: Direct/indirect follows heat-generated phases versus added foreign separating agent,not a mistaken contact/barrier classification.
Tray equipment can have continuous throughput but stagewise contact.
Binary mutual DAB=DBA is frame-consistent,not equality of unrelated self-diffusivities.
Stagnant B is not zero total molar flux;liquid constant-c formulas are stated approximations.
Equilibrium/operating lines use declared bases;linear Henry y,x is not exactly linear in X,Y.
Extraction products depend on solvent identity,not merely density;ternary figures/data examples are illustrative,not measured properties.
Door is interpreted as classical Dorr;Rotocell as Rotocel.Bollman has different co-/countercurrent runs.

15official suggested practicals,2h each;methods follow actual apparatus/SOP,blank observations only.Benzene/toxic/flammable systems require approved supervised facilities;no experiment completion claimed.
Practical12 missing second phase must be clarified from institutional manual;homogeneous binary acid/solvent mixtures alone cannot define interphase KD.
